description.value: Takara Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Burnaby whose name means 'treasure' — a nod to the freshness of their fish and the care put into their craft. They offer both dine-in and takeout service, plus online ordering, making them a convenient stop for a cycling lunch or dinner on Canada Way. The crew's emphasis on friendliness and quality sushi makes it a worthwhile detour for touring cyclists passing through the Burnaby corridor.
